title: A Letter from Mars
text: Hello! My name is Anna, and I am an astronaut.
I came to Mars two months ago.
Mars is red, and it is very cold here.
There is no water in the rivers, and you can't breathe the air.
Every day I grow potatoes in a small greenhouse.
My robot Rex helps me, but he can't cook.
Yesterday he made soup from my socks!
I miss my mum and her pancakes.
